name: Pre-Orders for WooCommerce – PreCart
author: tasin07

sections.description:
Are you looking for an effective way to sell pre-order products on your WooCommerce store? With Product Pre-Orders for WooCommerce, you can easily enable pre-orders for upcoming or out-of-stock products, allowing customers to reserve items before they are officially available. This feature helps increase sales, build anticipation, and streamline inventory management while providing a seamless shopping experience.

Whether you want to launch new products, manage limited stock, or gauge customer interest before manufacturing, our pre-order WooCommerce plugin makes it simple. Customers can place pre-orders just like regular purchases, even if the item is not currently in stock. This ensures they secure the products they want while you maintain full control over the pre-order process.

Pre-Orders Documentation | Support

Key Features of Product Pre-Orders for WooCommerce Free Version

🛒 Enable Pre-Orders on Any WooCommerce Product – Easily activate pre-orders for single or multiple products in your WooCommerce store.

📅 Custom Pre-Order Availability Date & Time – Set an exact release date and time for pre-order products, ensuring customers know when their orders will be fulfilled.

💵 Flexible Pre-Order Pricing Options – Charge customers upfront, charge when the product becomes available, or set custom pricing for pre-ordered products.

📨 Automatic Email Notifications – Send confirmation emails to customers who place pre-orders, keeping them informed about order status and product availability.

🚚 Manage Pre-Orders Easily – View and track all pre-orders within your WooCommerce dashboard, ensuring smooth processing and fulfillment.

🛍️ Supports Simple & Variable Products – Offer pre-orders on different product types, including variations like size, color, or bundle options.

Why Use Product Pre-Orders for WooCommerce?

Pre-Orders are common for things like video games, smartphones,Book launches,Music/album releases,Crowdfunded products, limited-edition products & many more niches. Companies use them to gauge demand and secure early sales.

📈 Increase Sales with Pre-Orders

By enabling pre-orders, you allow customers to buy upcoming or out-of-stock products, ensuring that you never miss a sale. This is especially useful for high-demand items, product launches, and seasonal sales.

🎉 Build Hype and Customer Excitement

Pre-ordering allows you to generate buzz before a product launch. Customers can secure their favorite products early, making them feel exclusive and valued.

📦 Improve Inventory Management

With pre-order WooCommerce functionality, you can forecast demand more accurately, helping you manage stock levels efficiently and reduce the risk of overproduction or understocking.

💌 Enhance Customer Experience

Customers appreciate transparency. By displaying the pre-order availability date and sending email updates, you provide a reliable and trustworthy shopping experience.

🎨 Customization for Better Branding

With flexible settings, you can modify pre-order buttons, colors, and messaging to align with your brand’s aesthetics, making the shopping experience seamless and professional.

Pre-Order Documentation | Support
sections.installation:
1. Upload the precart folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to **PreCart > Settings ** to configure the plugin.
  4. Enable pre-orders for individual products from the product edit page.
sections.faq:
How do I enable pre-orders for a product?

Navigate to your product edit screen, enable the “Pre-Order” checkbox in the Product Data section, and set your dates for each product. if you want to enable preorder for all products you can do it from PreCart > settings

Can I collect payments for pre-orders immediately?

Yes, you can collect payments for pre-orders immediately , we will add ‘pay later’ option in the pro version soon.

Does this work with my theme/other plugins?

Compatible with all WooCommerce-supported themes and most payment gateways.

How are pre-orders tracked in inventory?

Pre-orders deduct from a separate stock pool to avoid overselling.
